about: East Ardougne market's stall keepers and guards (Thieving 2 step T3): the baker (two), silk merchant, fur trader, silver merchant, spice seller and gem merchant who keep the six stalls, and the ardougne_guard type who watch them. Each tile and type is mejrs's; the keepers stand still and the guards wander 5 (both GUESSED, as the other markets').
